en:
How are you feeling today? Are you still
sore from the events of last night?

Yes, I'm fine. I've recharged the electricity
that I used on my recording function.

I'm very happy that I was finally able to use
my functions to help everyone!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo's recording function... It's not exactly
revolutionary technology, but it did help a lot.

Yes, thank you, Keebo. You really earned
your title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Oh, it was nothing, really. If you ever need my
help for anything, please don't hesitate to ask.
So...the magic show is starting soon, yes?

Everyone has probably gathered in the gym
already. We should get going as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the girls bathroom.
Ah, I don't want to cause any trouble...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
